rules.heading: THE ABODE OF THE NAKSHTRA OF MOOLA

planetary.freeform: Inauspicious effects occur depending on the realm where Moola resides in specific months (Heaven in Ashadha, Bhadrapada, Ashwin, Magha; Earth in Shravana, Kartika, Chaitra, Pausha; Underworld in Phalguna, Margashirsha, Vaishakha, Jyeshtha).

rules.notes: The asterism Moola brings inauspicious effects depending on whether it resides in Heaven, Earth, or the Underworld during specific months.

rules.heading: THE INAUSPICIOUS TIME FOR THE BIRTH OF A CHILD

planetary.freeform: Child birth occurring in Gandanta (Tithi, Nakshatra, Lagna), Tithi Kshaya, on a Sankranti, on Sinivali or Kuhu Amavasya, during Bhadra karana, or in the Janma Nakshatra of brother, sister, mother, or father is inauspicious and requires pacification (Shanti).

rules.notes: Birth during specified malefic yogas, ganda points, dark lunar nodes, and family birth-stars is inauspicious and requires Shanti rituals.
